title: DuplicateRecordSet - Data API
description: Represents a group of records that have been identified as duplicates. Each duplicate record set contains one or more duplicate record items. Use this object to create custom report types and view the results of duplicate jobs.

DuplicateRuleId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DuplicateRuleId.description: The duplicate rule used to identify this list of duplicate records.
DuplicateRuleId.label: Duplicate Rule ID

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The autogenerated name that’s given to the duplicate record set. Label is Duplicate Record Set Name.

RecordCount.description: The number of record items in the set.

ParentId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ParentId.description: The ParentId represents the parent of a duplicate rule or duplicate job. A ParentId is polymorphic. The label is Parent. This field is available in API versions 42.0 and later.

special_access_rules: To access this object, activate duplicate rules. A Salesforce admin must give users read and write access.
wsdl_segment:

        <element name="CreatedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="DuplicateRecordItems" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:QueryResult"/>
        <element name="DuplicateRule" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:DuplicateRule"/>
        <element name="DuplicateRuleId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="FlowOrchestrationWorkItems" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:QueryResult"/>
        <element name="IsDeleted" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="LastReferencedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="LastViewedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="Name" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="ProcessInstances" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:QueryResult"/>

        <element name="UserRecordAccess" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:UserRecordAccess"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
<simpleType name="QueryLocator">
  <restriction base="xsd:string"/>
</simpleType>
<complexType name="QueryResult">
  <sequence>
    <element name="done" type="xsd:boolean"/>
    <element name="queryLocator" type="tns:QueryLocator" nillable="true"/>
    <element name="records" type="ens:sObject" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/>
    <element name="size" type="xsd:int"/>
  </sequence>
</complexType>
